text:
Priya (Sales): Heads-up: AtlasCorp is moving toward a 12mo reserved deal. POC next Wed. They claim baseline ~700 RPS, short bursts to ~4.2k RPS for 5-15s, avg ~55 tokens/req, context ~800-1k tokens. Need reserved GPU recommendation, autoscale window, and quick pricing delta vs hosted. Any immediate concerns? @Maya @Devin

Maya (Solutions): Are bursts predictable (cron-like) or random? Also need their p95 target. KV reuse?

Priya (Sales): Bursts are semi-regular (every 8-12min), p95 target customer asked for 350ms, willing to relax to 450ms. They reported ~65% prefix reuse. Streaming on.

Devin (Platform Eng): With 65% reuse and int8 quantization, estimate A100-80GB gives ~260-340 p95 RPS per GPU with 20ms batching. H100 ~1.6x. For p95<=350ms I'd propose reserved fleet: 12 H100 (or ~19 A100-80) with autoscale up to 24 GPUs for spikes. Prewarm slots ~40-60/GPU and KV prefill.

Sam (SRE): Also recommend circuit-breaker route to a smaller hosted model under queue pressure to keep tail latencies bounded. Region fallback if AZ capacity exhausted.

Maya (Solutions): Draft autoscale snippet for POC: 
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_gpus: 12
  max_gpus: 24
  scale_up_threshold_rps: 2000
  scale_down_threshold_rps: 1300
  scale_up_cooldown_s: 60
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 240
prewarm:
  slots_per_gpu: 50
  kv_prefill: true
```
I'll also prepare prefill script and a runbook.

Devin (Platform Eng): Ballpark monthly reserved cost: 12 H100 ~$145k-190k; 19 A100-80GB slightly lower. Cold-start risk: if idle >30m and no prewarm/KV seed expect p95 1.0-1.6s. With prewarm+kv seed p95 usually <450ms. I'll perf-test against trace if Priya can get sanitized samples.

Priya (Sales): I'll ask AtlasCorp for sanitized traces and confirm SLO flexibility. Owners: Maya runbook + scripts; Devin perf tests + cost quote; Priya customer trace + legal loop. Thanks team.
